title: Onana clatters Kalajdžić, no penalty
summary: André Onana came out and crashed into Saša Kalajdžić in stoppage time. Simon Hooper ignored the claims and VAR Michael Salisbury checked but did not intervene. PGMOL apologised to Wolves straight after the match.
consequences: Jon Moss went to the Wolves dressing room at full time to admit the mistake, and Howard Webb also contacted Gary O'Neil.
Hooper and Salisbury were dropped for the next round of fixtures.

reactions.quote: Said Jon Moss apologised and told him it was a blatant penalty that should have been given.
